SELECT 
    o.orderspivot AS order_id,
    o.recordvault AS reference,
    o.mktnote AS market_pair,
    o.dealcount AS order_quantity,
    GREATEST(
        COALESCE((md.quote_depth_snapshot->'depth'->>'bidunits')::numeric, 0),
        COALESCE((md.quote_depth_snapshot->'depth'->>'askunits')::numeric, 0)

) md

    COALESCE((md.quote_depth_snapshot->'depth'->>'bidunits')::numeric, 0),
    COALESCE((md.quote_depth_snapshot->'depth'->>'askunits')::numeric, 0)
